name: unit_adventurer
weapon: short sword (lantern in the other hand)
description: Young adventurer with tousled brown hair, blue scarf, brown leather jacket over an orange shirt, brown trousers and boots, big backpack with a red bedroll and coiled rope; a short steel sword raised in his LEFT hand (screen-right), a brass lantern hanging from his RIGHT hand (screen-left)
wings_or_cape: blue scarf trailing to screen-left; large backpack with red bedroll and rope

name: unit_alazkan
description: Alazkan, the Svartalfar dark-elf assassin hero: pale lavender skin, pointed ears, long black hair in a high ponytail, black-and-purple leather armour with a purple mantle and brown straps, dark boots with tan trim, a purple cape trailing on the screen-left, a dark steel kite shield on his RIGHT arm (screen-left) and a curved steel dagger/short scimitar in his LEFT hand (screen-right)
wings_or_cape: purple cape trailing on the screen-left side

name: unit_angel
description: Angel: blonde female warrior in shining gold plate (breastplate, pauldrons, greaves) over a short white skirt, gold circlet, two big white feathered wings; a long steel sword raised in her RIGHT hand (screen-left), a round gold shield on her LEFT arm (screen-right).
wings_or_cape: two large white feathered wings spread up behind the shoulders

name: unit_angel_of_death
description: Angel of Death: hooded reaper in a dark grey robe with pale trim, white skull face, huge dark purple-black feathered wings on both sides, a long scythe held upright in his LEFT hand (screen-right) with the curved blade arching over the top right, his right hand (screen-left) open and clawed at the waist.
wings_or_cape: large dark purple-black feathered wings spread on both sides; full-length hooded robe

name: unit_assassin
description: Assassin: dark grey hood and black face mask, dark blue-grey leather armour with brown straps, red sash at the waist, crouched stance, a dagger in EACH hand (screen-left blade angled down-left, screen-right blade angled down-right).

name: unit_auric
description: Auric Ulvin (hero): white-haired, white-bearded god-king in silver-blue plate with ice-blue gem studs and a spiked ice-crystal crown, long white hair/mantle streaming down both sides; a huge glowing ice-blue crystal greatsword gripped in BOTH hands low on the screen-RIGHT side, blade angled up to the upper right.
wings_or_cape: long white hair/mantle flowing down the screen-left side to the ground, plus hair mass on the right

name: unit_azer
description: Azer: stocky bronze-skinned fire dwarf with blazing flame hair and a flame beard, bronze armoured skirt and greaves; a bronze war hammer raised behind his head in his LEFT hand (screen-right) and a round studded bronze shield on his RIGHT arm (screen-left).
wings_or_cape: flaming hair and beard (fire effect, keep)

name: unit_balor
description: Balor: huge hunched red demon with glowing yellow lava cracks, two curved dark horns, black fur mane, bone-tooth belt and dark loincloth, goat legs with hooves; a heavy iron warhammer in his LEFT hand (screen-right), a broken shackle with hooked chain dangling from his RIGHT wrist (screen-left).
wings_or_cape: shaggy black fur mane over the shoulders and back; long chains with hooks hanging from the screen-left wrist and the waist

name: unit_bambur
description: Bambur: stocky stone-skinned dwarf hero (grey rock skin and rock beard, glowing amber eyes) in bronze armour and a leather apron, gripping a big rune-marked stone warhammer with BOTH hands, hammer head out on the screen-right

name: unit_barnaxus
weapon: stone warhammer with a gear emblem
description: Barnaxus: tall bronze-gold clockwork golem hero with green patina, glowing blue eyes and a green head crest, blue sash tabard with a sapphire on the chest; a big grey stone warhammer held upright in his LEFT hand (screen-right), a rolled parchment scroll in his RIGHT hand (screen-left).
wings_or_cape: green crest fin on top of the head; blue cloth tabard/sash hanging down the front

name: unit_basium
description: Basium: angel knight in white-and-gold plate armour with a winged golden helm, blonde hair, blue tabard, huge white feathered wings, a longsword held upright at the chest by its hilt on the screen-right (LEFT hand on the grip, right forearm crossed over to it), blade rising to the upper right.
wings_or_cape: large white feathered wings on both sides; blue tabard; winged helm

name: unit_beastman
description: Beastman, a hunched wolf-headed warrior with grey-brown fur, blue war-paint stripes on face and body, tooth necklace and fur loincloth, raising a spiked wooden club in his SCREEN-LEFT hand overhead, round wooden shield with brown boss on his screen-right arm.

name: unit_beastmaster
description: Beastmaster: bearded hunter wearing a bear-head pelt hood, fang necklace, green tattoos and green kilt, a tall spear upright in his screen-LEFT hand, a hawk perched on his raised screen-right forearm and a grey wolf standing at his screen-right side facing right
wings_or_cape: bear-pelt cloak; companions to keep: hawk on the right arm and grey wolf at his right side

name: unit_berserker
description: Roaring red-bearded berserker wearing a brown bear pelt with the bear's head as a hood, bare muscular torso with blue war-paint stripes, fur loincloth and fur-wrapped boots; one steel axe raised high in his LEFT hand (screen-right), a second axe held low and out in his RIGHT hand (screen-left)
wings_or_cape: bear-pelt cloak hanging down the back with the bear head as a hood

name: unit_bloodpet
description: a Bloodpet, a gaunt frenzied Calabim thrall: pale skin, shaggy dark-brown hair, red-rimmed dark eyes and a gaping bloody mouth, bare chest with a dark choker, ragged black loincloth with a red sash across the chest and red tattered waist cloth, dark wraps on the legs with red bands, a wooden club studded with bone-coloured knobs raised high in his RIGHT hand (screen-left) and a round red-and-black wooden shield with steel studs and rim on his LEFT arm (screen-right)

name: unit_bone_golem
description: Bone golem: a hulking construct of carved ivory bones bound with gold bands set with blue gems, with an elephant-skull head with tusks and a ribcage torso; a huge bone club raised in the screen-RIGHT fist, the screen-left fist hanging low.

name: unit_brigit
description: Brigit: fire-angel heroine with long flowing red hair and a gold circlet, gold breastplate and pauldrons, red skirt, gold greaves, fiery orange feathered wings behind, a flaming golden sword raised in her LEFT hand (screen-right); her right fist is at her side (screen-left).
wings_or_cape: fiery orange-red feathered wings behind, spreading to screen-left; long hair flowing to screen-left

name: unit_brujah
description: Brujah: pale bald vampire brute with red eyes, fangs, pointed ears and a red scar on the scalp, bare muscular torso, black spiked pauldron on the screen-right shoulder, tattered red cloth, black boots; a huge black double-bladed battle-axe raised over the screen-left shoulder in BOTH hands.
wings_or_cape: tattered red cloth strips hanging from shoulder and waist

name: unit_chaos_marauder
description: Chaos marauder: red-skinned demon with two horns (one large and curved), yellow eyes, fangs and pink rune marks, black-and-orange spiked armour with a big pauldron on the screen-right shoulder, purple loincloth and chains; a jagged curved rune cleaver in his LEFT hand (screen-right) and a round spiked rune shield on his RIGHT arm (screen-left).
wings_or_cape: two horns (large curved horn at upper right)

name: unit_circle_of_urd
weapon: large boulder held overhead (wooden club hangs at the hip)
description: Circle of Urd berserker: bare-chested Doviello warrior with red war paint, blond beard, grey wolf-pelt hood and cloak, fur loincloth with a fang belt, fur boots; lifts a big grey boulder over his head in BOTH hands, a wooden club slung at his screen-right hip.
wings_or_cape: grey wolf-pelt hood and cloak hanging down the back to the screen-right

name: unit_clockwork_golem
description: Clockwork golem, a bulky gold-brass automaton with blue pauldrons and blue thigh plates bearing gold gear emblems, a round chest window showing gears, a domed head with two round blue lens-eyes, a big wind-up key on its back, and a spiked brass mace-ball for a fist on EACH arm.
wings_or_cape: wind-up key on the back (upper right)

name: unit_commander
weapon: golden-headed scepter/baton (sheathed sword at the screen-left hip)
description: Commander: bearded general with a golden laurel wreath, steel plate armour with gold trim and a long red cape, pointing a gold-knobbed scepter forward in his screen-RIGHT hand, screen-left hand at his belt by a sheathed sword
wings_or_cape: long red cape behind both sides

name: unit_courtesan
description: Courtesan: slender woman with voluminous piled red hair, a gold masquerade mask, off-shoulder purple and gold gown with black corset and long black gloves; a black lace fan raised in her screen-right hand by her face and a small dagger held low, point down-left, in her screen-left hand

name: unit_crusader
description: a Crusader: a bearded holy warrior in a steel kettle helmet with a gold cross, grey chain-mail coif and hauberk, a white tabard with a gold sun emblem and red trim, a brown belt, a long white red-edged cape, brown boots, a steel flanged mace raised high in his LEFT hand (screen-right), and his RIGHT hand (screen-left) holding the straps of a white satchel with a red cross and a brown bag with a gold cross
wings_or_cape: long white cape with red trim hanging behind on both sides

name: unit_demagog
description: Demagog: wild-haired, bearded zealot shouting, in a torn white robe over a blue tunic with a red sash, sandals; a studded wooden club raised high in the screen-RIGHT hand and a wooden cross on a rosary dangling from the screen-LEFT hand.

name: unit_demon
description: Demon: muscular red horned demon with curved bone horns, red bat wings, a dark loincloth with a gold-studded belt, spiked wristbands and hooves, a serrated black-red blade held in its LEFT hand (screen-right); its right hand is a clawed fist on screen-left.
wings_or_cape: large red bat wings on both sides; barbed arrow-tipped tail curling at screen-left

name: unit_diseased_corpse
description: Diseased Corpse: hunched yellow-green zombie with pustules, scraggly brown hair, ragged grey-green tunic and torn brown loincloth, bare feet, bandaged screen-RIGHT arm reaching forward with clawed fingers, screen-left arm hanging; purple flies buzz around his head

name: unit_donal
description: Donal (hero): bearded brown-haired knight with a scarred face, steel pauldrons, red tabard with a gold sun, gold belt, brown gauntlets and boots and a red cape; a steel longsword with a gold crossguard held blade-up to the upper-right in his RIGHT (screen-right) hand, a small hand axe hanging at his screen-left hip
wings_or_cape: red cape billowing to the screen-left

name: unit_drown
description: Drown: pale-blue drowned undead with dark hair tangled with green seaweed, a starfish on its shoulder, a ragged blue tunic with white V collar and torn brown trousers, holding a trident two-handed diagonally, prongs up at screen-right (front hand screen-right, rear hand low on screen-left), water drops falling.
wings_or_cape: seaweed strands hanging from hair and body

name: unit_duin
weapon: claws (raised clawed hand), plus a gnawed bone in the other hand
description: Baron Duin Halfmorn: a huge hulking charcoal-black werewolf lord with a silver-grey mane, yellow eyes and a small gold circlet, in a torn crimson baron's coat with gold trim and buttons and a gold chain with a medallion. He raises the black claws of his LEFT hand (screen-right) to strike and holds a big gnawed bone low in his RIGHT hand (screen-left).
wings_or_cape: tattered crimson coat tails and half-cape flapping behind on the left

name: unit_dwarven_shadow
description: Dwarven Shadow: stocky dwarf assassin in a dark grey hood and cloak, glowing orange eyes, long white braided beard, brown leather bracers and boots, blue sash, belt pouches and a small crossbow at the screen-left hip, a reverse-grip dagger in EACH hand pointing down and out to both sides.
wings_or_cape: dark grey hooded cloak

name: unit_dwarven_soldier_runes
description: Runed Dwarven Soldier: a stocky dwarf in bronze-and-gold plate and a full bronze helmet with cheek guards, with a long dark-grey beard, holding a steel battle axe raised in his screen-RIGHT hand and a big round grey shield with a glowing orange rune on his screen-left arm.

name: unit_eidolon
weapon: halberd / poleaxe (crescent axe blade with spear tip and red cross)
description: Eidolon, a dark knight in black plate with gold trim and spiked pauldrons, a black helm with large curved horns and a red cross visor, and a tattered red tabard. He holds a tall crescent-bladed halberd upright in his LEFT hand (screen-right) and raises an open clawed right gauntlet (screen-left) bearing a red rune.
wings_or_cape: tattered red cloth/tabard flaring at the hips

name: unit_einherjar
description: Einherjar, a ghostly pale-blue spectral viking warrior in a winged helmet with nasal guard, long braided beard, mail and plate, holding a battle axe upright in his SCREEN-RIGHT hand and a large round shield with central boss on his screen-left arm, cape hanging behind on the right.
wings_or_cape: small wings on the helmet; cape behind on the screen-right

name: unit_flagbearer
weapon: tall banner pole with a gold spear tip, held upright in both hands (short sword sheathed at the hip)
description: Flagbearer: a soldier in a steel kettle half-helm, a chainmail shirt under a red tabard with gold trim and brown boots, with a short sword sheathed at his screen-left hip, holding upright with BOTH hands at his screen-RIGHT side a tall wooden pole with a gold spear tip that flies a big red swallow-tailed banner with a gold border and gold star streaming to the screen-left.
wings_or_cape: large red swallow-tailed banner with a gold star, flying to the upper-left from the pole

name: unit_flesh_golem
description: Flesh golem: bald, hulking, stitched patchwork brute with pink, tan, pale-yellow and purple skin patches, iron neck bolts, yellow eyes and a ragged brown loincloth with a belt. His enormous stitched LEFT arm (screen-right) has an iron wrist band and ends in a giant fist; the smaller RIGHT fist (screen-left) also has an iron band.

name: unit_freak
description: Freak, a hulking pale-green stitched mutant with a second one-eyed horned head on its left shoulder, a ragged brown loincloth and a shackle with broken chain dangling from the screen-left wrist. A huge orange crab claw serves as the arm on screen-right.
wings_or_cape: extra one-eyed head on the left shoulder; hanging chain

name: unit_frostling
description: Frostling: small blue-skinned goblin with spiky white hair, huge pointed ears and icicles, ragged white fur tunic with brown belt, an ice-tipped wooden spear upright in his screen-RIGHT hand

name: unit_gargoyle
description: Gargoyle: grey stone gargoyle crouched on bent legs, with curled ram horns, orange eyes, a toothy grin, pointed ears, a blue sash with an orange square brooch and stone bat wings, its clawed right forearm reaching forward on screen-right.
wings_or_cape: stone bat wings (big one at screen-left, second tip behind at upper right); tail curling at lower screen-left

name: unit_gibbon
description: Gibbon Goetia: thin sly hero in a charcoal-grey and black hooded robe with crimson lining and gold trim, a smiling white porcelain mask, the other arm bound across his chest in a crimson sling, a grey frowning mask and pouch on the belt; a thin curved dagger held low in his LEFT hand (screen-right), pointing down-right.
wings_or_cape: long hooded robe/coat reaching the shins

name: unit_goblin
description: Goblin: a small hunched green goblin with big pointed ears, yellow eyes and a toothy grin, in a ragged brown tunic with a rope belt, holding a spear upright in his screen-RIGHT hand, with the free screen-left arm hanging in a claw.

name: unit_golem
description: Iron golem: massive armoured construct of dark steel plates with riveted bronze and gold bands and rust streaks, a domed head with a glowing orange visor slit, and huge clenched iron fists at both sides.

name: unit_greater_werewolf
description: Huge hunched charcoal-grey werewolf with a spiky white mane down its back, red eyes and snarling fangs, a broken iron chain collar round its neck, torn brown trousers with a rope belt; big ivory claws on both hands, the LEFT (screen-right) arm reaching forward and the RIGHT (screen-left) arm hanging low
wings_or_cape: white spiky mane down the back and arm on screen-left; broken chain collar

name: unit_gurid
description: Gurid the Great Beast: gigantic brown cave bear rearing on its hind legs, roaring with open jaws, both clawed forepaws up (the screen-right paw raised higher), long ivory claws, frosted grey-white shoulder mane with broken arrows stuck in it, pale scars on the chest, bone-and-skull necklace.
wings_or_cape: grey-white shaggy mane over the shoulders with broken arrows and spear shafts stuck in it; bone-and-tooth fetish necklace

name: unit_guybrush
description: Guybrush: grinning blond pirate with a ponytail, blue gold-buttoned coat, white shirt, red sash, dark grey trousers and brown boots, a rapier thrust out to the right in his LEFT hand (screen-right), right hand (screen-left) a fist at the hip.
wings_or_cape: ponytail; coat tails

name: unit_harlequin
description: Harlequin: a lean, crouching jester in a tight violet, gold-yellow and black diamond-checkered bodysuit, a three-pointed violet-and-gold jester hat with gold bells, a white ruff and a chalk-white manic-grinning face with black-ringed eyes, raising a curved dagger high in his screen-LEFT hand and holding a second curved dagger low in his screen-right hand, with curly-toed black shoes with bells.
wings_or_cape: three-pointed jester hat with bells; white ruff collar

name: unit_hill_giant
description: Hill giant: huge muscular giant with wild brown hair and beard, hide tunic, a grey wolf pelt on the screen-right shoulder, rope belt with stone sling pouches, leg wraps, bare feet; a tree-trunk club resting across his shoulders, gripped in his RIGHT fist (screen-left) by his head, his LEFT arm hanging with a clenched fist.
wings_or_cape: grey wolf pelt on the screen-right shoulder

name: unit_hyborem
description: Hyborem: huge red demon with large dark curved horns, black and gold spiked plate armour, red cape trailing on the right, flames around the feet, a flaming jagged greatsword held upright in his screen-LEFT hand (his right), screen-right hand a clenched fist.
wings_or_cape: red cape on screen-right; horns

name: unit_immortal
description: Immortal: warrior in ornate gold armour with a full gold helm and a tall red crest, red cape and red tabard, a large oval gold shield with a red sun emblem on the screen-left (right arm), a curved scimitar raised in his LEFT hand (screen-right).
wings_or_cape: red cape behind; tall red helmet crest

name: unit_ira
description: Ira: crouching red-skinned demon with a wild spiky black mane, black tiger stripes, spiked bracers and a ragged black loincloth; a curved jagged blade raised high in his screen-right hand and a second blade held low and forward in his screen-left hand

name: unit_lizardman
description: Lizardman: green scaly lizard warrior with a yellow belly, orange-red head frill, tooth necklace and brown loincloth; a stone-tipped wooden spear held upright in his RIGHT hand (screen-left), a round orange-and-red painted wooden shield with an iron boss on his LEFT arm (screen-right).
wings_or_cape: long green tail with orange stripe curling out to the screen-left; orange-red head frill

name: unit_lizardman_beastmaster
weapon: spear with a jagged bone head
description: Lizardman beastmaster: green lizardman with an orange spiky crest, bone-tooth necklace, leopard-skin mantle and tribal skirt, a spear with a jagged white bone head held upright in his RIGHT hand (screen-left), a red hawk perched on his gloved LEFT hand (screen-right), and a brown weasel companion climbing at his screen-right foot.
wings_or_cape: lizard tail curling at the screen-left; hawk on the screen-right arm; weasel companion at the feet

name: unit_loki
description: Loki: grinning red-haired elf trickster in a green-and-purple jester costume with gold bells and a belled jester hat, purple cape behind on the left, curved dagger held low in the screen-LEFT hand, white comedy mask raised in the screen-RIGHT hand, gold sparkles around it.
wings_or_cape: purple and green cape on screen-left; jester hat with bells

name: unit_losha
description: Losha Valas (hero): pale vampire woman with long black hair and red eyes in a black-and-red armoured dress with a high red collar and pauldrons; a curved scimitar held out in the screen-RIGHT hand with the blade curving up to the upper right.
wings_or_cape: red cape flaring out to the lower left

name: unit_lucian
description: Lucian, Doviello chieftain: a broad barbarian with a shaggy brown beard and blue war-paint stripes, wearing a grey wolf pelt with the wolf's head as a hood. He has blue tattoo bands on his tanned arms, a round metal amulet on his bare chest, a brown leather and fur kilt, and fur-trimmed boots, in a wide stance. He grips a huge steel double-bladed battle axe across his body in BOTH hands, with the blade raised at the upper screen-right.
wings_or_cape: long grey wolf-pelt cloak hanging down the screen-left side to the knees

name: unit_lunatic
description: Lunatic: bald madman with wild white hair tufts, a forehead scar, one bulging eye and a manic grin, in a torn blood-stained cream straitjacket with brown straps and buckles, ragged grey trousers, bare feet; a bloody cleaver raised high in his LEFT hand (screen-right), a broken chain dangling from his RIGHT fist (screen-left).

name: unit_manes
description: Manes: gaunt, hunched yellow-green demon with small horns, pointed ears, glowing yellow eyes and fangs, long dangling clawed arms, a ragged brown loincloth, and a barbed tail curling out to the LEFT; fights with claws.
wings_or_cape: barbed tail on screen-left; small horns

name: unit_maros
description: Maros: dwarf hero in grey steel plate with gold trim, horned steel helmet with a gold crest, braided red beard, red cape and a round gold-rimmed shield on his back (screen-left); a gold-ornamented double-bladed battle-axe held diagonally in BOTH hands (low hand at screen-left x~38,y~90; high hand at screen-right x~60,y~72), its head at the upper screen-right.
wings_or_cape: red cape behind at screen-left; round shield slung on the back; helmet horns

name: unit_mary
description: Mary Morbus: a hunched undead girl with pale grey-green skin, tiny yellow eyes and long stringy black hair, in a torn dirty white nightgown with sickly green stains. Both hands have long claw nails, raised and reaching to the right, and she stands on a twisted leg among floating green plague blobs.
wings_or_cape: floating green plague droplets around her (left side and by the feet)

name: unit_mercenary
weapon: curved scimitar resting on the shoulder
description: Mercenary: burly bald sellsword with a black topknot, a scar over one eye and a black moustache, steel pauldron, brown leather jerkin with studded straps, red sash with a gold medallion, coin pouch, brown boots; a curved scimitar gripped in his LEFT hand (screen-right) with the blade resting back over his shoulders toward screen-left.
wings_or_cape: fur-trimmed tattered brown cloak hanging behind on the screen-left

name: unit_meshabber
weapon: flaming black greatsword (plus a spiked chain flail)
description: Meshabber (demon hero): huge dark-grey demon with lava cracks over his skin, curled ram horns, red bat wings, spiked black pauldrons and greaves, a red loincloth; a flaming jagged black sword in his screen-right hand and a long spiked chain flail hanging from his screen-left hand
wings_or_cape: two red-brown bat wings spread on both sides; ram horns

name: unit_minotaur
description: Minotaur: muscular brown bull-headed warrior with cream horns, red eyes and a gold nose ring, black spiked pauldrons with gold studs, studded leather belt and kilt, gripping a double-bladed battle axe across the body with BOTH hands, axe head on the screen-RIGHT.
wings_or_cape: horns

name: unit_mithril_golem
description: Mithril golem: hulking steel-blue mithril construct with gold runes and trim, a bearded visored helmet with a gold T-crest and a glowing yellow eye slit, gold belt and runed tabard; a giant runed warhammer resting across its shoulders with the haft in the screen-RIGHT fist and the hammer head up behind the screen-left shoulder; screen-left fist hangs empty.

name: unit_monk
description: Monk: bald monk with a large wooden prayer-bead necklace, dark grey sleeveless vest over a white shirt, blue sash, baggy white trousers, wrapped forearms and sandals; a long wooden quarterstaff held diagonally in BOTH hands, his LEFT hand high at screen-right and his RIGHT hand low at screen-left, the leading end down at lower-left.

name: unit_moroi
weapon: big single-bitted battle axe with a red haft
description: Moroi: a chalk-white vampire-blooded warrior with glowing red eyes and bared fangs, in a black open steel helm, a red tabard with a black bat emblem over chainmail, black gauntlets and boots. He holds a big battle axe across his body in BOTH hands, with the steel blade raised at the upper screen-right.

name: unit_muirin
description: Muirin: gaunt pale blue-grey sea creature with long black and green dreadlocks, ragged teal and green rags, brown leather harness with a sack on its back, dripping water drops, barefoot, a rusty bronze trident held two-handed diagonally across the body with the prongs up at the screen-left (RIGHT hand high near the prongs, LEFT hand low near the butt at the screen-right).
wings_or_cape: long dreadlocks; sack on the back

name: unit_myconid
description: Myconid: a walking mushroom with a big red cap spotted with cream, a cream fibrous stalk body with two glowing yellow eyes under the cap, clusters of small teal mushrooms on both shoulders and floating lime-green spore balls, standing on root-like legs and holding a knobbly pale wooden club raised in its screen-LEFT hand, with root-claw fingers on the screen-right.
wings_or_cape: wide spotted mushroom cap overhanging both sides; small teal mushrooms on both shoulders; floating spore balls

name: unit_ogre_embers
description: Clan of Embers ogre, a huge green-skinned brute with red war paint, tusks, bone-tooth necklace, fur shoulder wrap and fur boots, brown belt and red loincloth, hefting a spiked wooden club over his shoulder in his SCREEN-LEFT fist (club head behind his head at the upper right with ember sparks), screen-right fist hanging at his side.

name: unit_ogre_warchief
description: Ogre Warchief: huge green ogre with tusks, red war paint, horned helmet with a skull, fang-and-skull necklace, fur pauldron and orange cape on the screen-left, a giant spiked club resting across his shoulders gripped in his screen-RIGHT hand, spiked end over the left shoulder
wings_or_cape: tattered orange cape and fur on the screen-left side

name: unit_orthus
description: Orthus (orc hero): hulking green orc with tusks, a black topknot and scarred brow, a spiked black pauldron on his screen-left shoulder, a tooth necklace, skull belt and red loincloth; a huge double-bitted steel axe resting across his shoulders, held by the red-wrapped haft in his screen-right hand with the axe head behind him at the upper-left, his screen-left hand a free fist

name: unit_paladin
description: Paladin: blond young knight in full silver plate armour with gold trim and a white tabard with a gold sun, spiked mace raised in his screen-LEFT hand, white kite shield with a gold sun on the screen-RIGHT arm.

name: unit_paramander
description: a Paramander, a Khazad dwarf champion in bronze-gold plate armour: a bronze helmet with a gold gem on the brow, a big braided brown beard, grey steel pauldrons, a brown tabard with a gold rune, a round bronze shield with a gold rune on his RIGHT arm (screen-left), and a big steel warhammer with gold runes held two-handed across his body, the haft end in his RIGHT hand (screen-left, low) and his LEFT hand (screen-right) higher up, the hammer head up at the screen-right

name: unit_pyre_zombie
description: Pyre zombie: bloated dark-brown corpse with glowing orange lava cracks and flames rising from its shoulders and head, ragged purple loincloth tied with rope and a hanging chain; both clawed hands hang at its sides
wings_or_cape: flames on the shoulders and head

name: unit_radiant_guard
weapon: halberd / poleaxe with a gold sun finial
description: a Radiant Guard, a holy knight in polished silver plate with gold trim: a closed great helm with a T-visor crowned by a golden sunburst crest, a blue tabard with a gold sun emblem, a brown belt, a white cape hanging on the screen-left, steel greaves and gold-trimmed sabatons, and a halberd with a curved steel blade and a gold sun finial on a wooden shaft in his LEFT hand (screen-right); his RIGHT hand (screen-left) is an empty gauntleted fist
wings_or_cape: white cape on the screen-left; gold sunburst crest on the helm

name: unit_rantine
description: Rantine, the orc warlord: green-skinned orc with a dark mohawk, scarred face and tusks, a spiked steel pauldron, orange sash and loincloth over dark leather, brown boots; a notched curved sword held low in the screen-RIGHT hand and a round wooden shield with a steel boss on the screen-LEFT arm.

name: unit_rathus
